Chapter 151 - 151 I've Acquired This Real Estate; I'm Launching a New Item!

151 I’ve Acquired This Real Estate; I’m Launching a New Item!

Lin Fan chatted with the interpreter for a while more before hanging up.

However, he did not leave. Instead, he sent a message to Qiu Ziqian.

After a while, Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling came down from the 25th floor.

When they saw the pile of clothes and bags in the living room, their eyes lit up.

“The limited edition steamer!”

“The limited edition LV Crafty that was released the day before yesterday!”

“LV Tribute!”

…

The two of them could not help but scream.

They used to be air stewardesses and knew all kinds of branded goods.

After resigning, they would also look for clothes and bags online when they had nothing to do.

Therefore, they recognized the brand and model of the clothes and bags at a glance.

Any one of them was expensive and limited edition.

In this room, they were randomly piled on the floor. The number of things here…There were probably hundreds or even thousands of them!

This… This was simply unimaginable!

Lin Fan looked at their shocked expressions and said casually, “These clothes and bags are all mine. You can use them as you wish.”

“Heavens!”

When Lin Fan asked Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling to come down…

They had already guessed this possibility.

However, after Lin Fan confirmed it, they could not help but be shocked.

“Darling, why did you suddenly buy so many LV limited edition clothes and bags?” Qiu Ziqian could not help but ask.

“Oh, I didn’t buy them. The president of LV sent them over. Not only that, but he also said that every time LV releases a new product in the future, he’ll send one over. Because I bought 5% of LV’s shares,” Lin Fan said.

Naturally, Lin Fan would not say that he had received 5% of LV’s shares from the 1,300 red packets he had received two days ago.

The system and red packets… they were all his secrets.

“Heavens!”

Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling cried out in shock again.

Every time LV released a new product, they would send one to Lin Fan… In other words, he would have an endless supply of LV products in the future?

Lin Fan actually bought 5% of LV’s shares!

That was LV!

Its market value exceeded a trillion!

5% of the shares was more than 50 billion!

This… It was completely beyond their imagination!

However, what they did not know was that Lin Fan not only owned 5% of LV’s shares, but he also owned 5% of Penguin’s shares!

Otherwise, their expressions would definitely be even more interesting than now.

After a long time, Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling finally calmed down. They picked out their favorite clothes and bags and returned to the 25th floor happily.

“Brother Lin Fan, the LV clothes and bags are all on the fifth floor. Could it be that… you bought the fifth floor too?”

Lin Fan shook his head. “Not just the fifth floor. I bought the entire building.”

“All of it?”

The two of them widened their eyes again and shouted in surprise.

Other people would have to worry about buying a house for a long time.

Lin Fan directly bought an entire building?

Lin Fan did not care about their shock. He casually threw out a bunch of spare keys and said, “If you feel that it’s too crowded to live together in the future, you can go anywhere you want.”

Instantly, Huang Ling and Qiu Ziqian looked at Lin Fan even more fervently.

In order to let them be relaxed and at ease, Lin Fan actually bought the entire building.

With a man like this, what could a woman ask for?

The next moment, the two of them pounced into Lin Fan’s embrace.

It was nighttime, and the third block was even more lively than usual.

On the distant horizon, a string of fireworks rose and blossomed into gorgeous flowers.

…

The next day.

Since it was Saturday, Lin Fan sat on the sofa after breakfast and casually scrolled through his phone.

At this moment, his phone vibrated slightly.

It was Chu Yunyue.

Chu Yunyue: [Our company is preparing to launch a new product. Do you have time to come over and take a look?]

Lin Fan replied without any hesitation.

Lin Fan said: [Okay, I’ll come over later.]

Then, Lin Fan chatted with Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling, who looked exhausted, before driving the Lamborghini toward Feiyang Building.

In the past, the advertisements at the entrance of Feiyang Building were for cars and electronic products.

Now, there was a large logo of Flower Stem, which was very eye-catching.

When Lin Fan took the elevator to the 17th floor, a familiar fragrance wafted over.

Last time, Flower Stem’s company seemed a little empty.

At this moment, it was bustling with activity.

When the receptionist saw Lin Fan, she quickly stood up and said in a very respectful tone, “Hello, Mr. Lin.”

Recently, Flower Stem had been doing well.

Even the bonuses and wages of all employees had increased substantially.

The receptionist knew very well that all of this was because of Lin Fan.

In addition, Lin Fan had a good relationship with the president, Chu Yunyue, and he owned 30% of the company’s shares.

No matter how one looked at it, Lin Fan was worthy of respect.

Lin Fan nodded his head. “Hello.”

“Mr. Lin, are you here to see the president? The president is in the office now.”

“Alright,” Lin Fan replied.

Then, he strode into the company.

After a dull knocking sound, a pleasant voice came from the president’s office.

“Please come in.”

At this moment, Chu Yunyue seemed to be reviewing some important documents. She was so focused that she did not raise her head immediately.

Lin Fan looked at her from afar.

He had not seen Chu Yunyue for some time since he last saw her at Hu Tian’s house.

Today, Chu Yunyue was wearing a white-collar suit. She looked very capable, and her full figure was perfectly highlighted.

There was a hint of fatigue on her quiet face, but it was also filled with excitement.

Obviously, the company had been very busy during this period of time.

At the same time, she was very satisfied.

This made Lin Fan’s heart ache, but at the same time, he felt happy for her.

Serious people were the most beautiful.

At this moment, Chu Yunyue exuded an unparalleled charm.

Chu Yunyue finally raised her head.

When she saw that it was Lin Fan, a smile that was hard to hide appeared on her face.

“Lin Fan, why didn’t you tell me you were coming? Sit down! I’ll pour you a cup of tea first.”

As Chu Yunyue spoke, she threw the documents aside and got up to make tea.

Although she was very dedicated to her work, it was obvious that Lin Fan was more important to her.

After a while, the office was filled with the fragrance of tea.

Lin Fan picked up the cup of tea and took a sip.

“How does it taste?” asked Chu Yunyue hurriedly.

“It’s sweet, elegant, and fragrant. It’s a very delicious tea,” Lin Fan said.

“I’m glad you like it,” Chu Yunyue said happily as if she had received the greatest praise.

“Oh right, what kind of perfume are you preparing to launch?”
